rows.name: passkey-fresh
rows.note: A person supplied this passkey redemption hash. The transaction does not prove which phones created or scanned the code.

rows.name: 1a-success
rows.note: One account signs the entry and a second account submits it. The party that submits selects the recipient after the signature exists.

rows.name: 1b-double-spend-failed
rows.note: The network refuses a second submission of the same signed entry, because it consumed the nonce.

rows.name: 1c-expired-host-signature-failed
rows.note: The network refuses an entry whose signature expiration ledger is in the past.

rows.name: 8-void-success
rows.note: The payer voids the voucher and redeems it to their own address. The redemption spends the nonce, and the balance does not change.

rows.name: 8-after-void-failed
rows.note: The network refuses a redemption of a voucher that the payer voided.

rows.name: task3-handbuilt
rows.note: A client that never called simulation built this voucher. The redemption succeeds.

rows.name: lifetime-5m
rows.note: A voucher with a lifetime of 60 ledgers, about 5 minutes.

rows.name: lifetime-15m
rows.note: A voucher with a lifetime of 180 ledgers, about 15 minutes. This lifetime is the default.

rows.name: lifetime-1h
rows.note: A voucher with a lifetime of 720 ledgers, about 1 hour.

rows.name: lifetime-12h
rows.note: A voucher with a lifetime of 8,640 ledgers, about 12 hours. This lifetime equals the cap of the contract.

rows.name: sep7-payment
rows.note: A merchant published a signed request and a payer answered it. This is the payee-presented direction, which the voucher rows reverse.
